CustomField.description: Header title rich text shown when Show Header is checked. Passed as the title to c-flow-form / c-flow-form-repeat / c-flow-data-table / c-header. Distinct from the internal Title field (which only names the section in the builder).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The visible heading shown at the top of this section when Show Header is on. This is what form users see, unlike the internal section name.
CustomField.label: Title
